messages.subject: Garrety - internal strategy thoughts
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

My concern is the age angle - the two new consolidated roles were both lined up for people in their 40s and the paper trail on selection is thin. That's our real exposure, not the unfair dismissal. I think we settle rather than run it.

Elena is pulling the restructuring board papers to check the chronology against the November disclosure date.

Tom

messages.plaintextBody:
Agreed. Settle. Make sure the offer is a protected conversation as well as without prejudice so it can't be used in an ordinary UD claim if talks fail. Get board authority for a ceiling and don't open above c.£85k on the ex-gratia.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
